name: within-privacy-bridge
description: Runs in the vendor's environment: pulls CRM/database outcomes, pseudonymizes identifiers locally, pushes only pseudonymous events to Within.

scripts.check: node --check src/bridge.mjs && node --check src/lib.mjs && node --check src/adapters/salesforce.mjs && node --check src/adapters/postgres.mjs
scripts.test:integration: docker compose -f test/integration/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait && node --test 'test/integration/*.test.mjs'; docker compose -f test/integration/docker-compose.yml down -v
